name: DataComp
description: DataComp is a benchmark and testbed for multimodal dataset experiments, providing a large candidate pool of image-text pairs and standardized evaluation through training CLIP models and testing on 38 downstream tasks to study dataset quality and scaling.
reputation: Widely used as a standard testbed for data curation and scaling studies in multimodal representation learning, especially CLIP-style models.
notes: Enables research on dataset design and filtering at scale; baseline achieves strong zero-shot ImageNet accuracy.
